text: This report recommends approval of registration and travel expenses for Mr. Gilles Bouchard, Director Event Management Services to attend the first year and the second year respectively of the International Association of Venue Managers (IAVM), Venue Management School and approval for Mr. Tony Porter, Director Parking and Security Services to attend the City sponsored Masters Certificate in Municipal Leadership from the Schulich School of Business at York University.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Authorized expenses for Gilles Bouchard, Director, Event Management Services to attend the International Association of Venue Managers in Wheeling, West Virginia in 2018 and 2019, at a cost not to exceed $5,500 plus HST each year. 2. Authorized the registration fees for Tony Porter, Director, Parking and Security Services to attend the City sponsored Masters Certificate in Municipal Leadership course at the Schulich School of Business at York University not to exceed $9,850 plus HST in 2018.
